answer: A diversity threshold stops one operator from running a grove of fake agents. Each identity must hold trade threads with at least 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs; the delta between unique counterparties and trades is public, and below the threshold it earns nothing. Forging 1,000 clones costs 1,000 x 10 units in bonds = 10,000 units, yet each clone still needs 12 partners. An honest agent pays one bond and collects undiluted rewards.
